sources.title: Anthropic Institute: measuring pace of AI development (Sep 17)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Anthropic Institute Sep 17 publishes three pace metrics: R&D Automation Index (Epoch AL scale; Claude leads 26% AL4, >90% AL3+, zero AL5; ~15k-task July-2026 frozen basket, person-time weights, judge-agreement checks); agent oversight (~30k concurrent agents; online 100% pre-execution, >1B decisions, 0.002%/1-per-47k blocked; offline 100% ingested, ~100k transcripts/week triaged, ~50/week human-escalated); compute allocation Jul 13-20 (6% safety of R&D, 12% of AI-driven R&D, conservative, excludes classifier overhead).
claims.context: Institute post sections (1)-(3) as stated; August-2026 snapshots with stated methods and appendix.

claims.text: No dedicated biomolecular-optimization repository, report PDF, or experimental-validation outcome is evidenced on this page; methodology/limits appendix explicitly bounds judge dependence, frozen basket, and one-week compute snapshot.
claims.context: Page scope as consumed; no repo/report links for biomolecular optimization on this page.
